hardware.variant: One assembled kit, operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2; a left-slot camera module was connected.

inputs.name: Static FFS RAM root with LVGL and I²C reader
inputs.revision: LVGL example b1afcfbe0c3ef008a44bb5aae11a2dbfa937597f; I²C reader eac32cff3302728d3661bb00b06c4c8cc57d61cf; console-tools 06be3ad3bfec7e98e214059b21e18a195ac3d2be

scenario: Boot the test kernel and RAM root, observe display and touch driver attachment, run the LVGL example, and read selected peripheral identification registers and the left-slot module EEPROM.
expected: The kernel attaches the devices, the LVGL example displays a visible interface, and addressed I²C reads return independently checkable identification data.
observed: CO5300 framebuffer/wsdisplay, both GPIO I²C buses and CST9220 touch/wsmouse attached. The controller reported project 0x6854 and 480 × 480. The LVGL example remained running after an eight-second wait while the UART shell remained responsive; the user reported a completely black screen. The camera EEPROM had ESP magic, camera board type, hardware version 0x0102, and three valid CRCs. BMI270 address 0x69 register 0x00 returned 0x24; individual ES8311 registers 0xfd, 0xfe and 0xff returned 0x83, 0x11 and 0x01. Reads of OV3640 ID registers returned I/O errors before sensor power/reset configuration.
limits: One assembled V1.2 sample only; this was a RAM test and does not update the installed NOR image.
The display remained black despite the running process; touch-coordinate operation was not tested.
EEPROM identifies the camera module, not the sensor silicon. The sensor ID and camera frame capture remain unverified; sensor power and reset were not configured.
Register identification does not establish audio playback, motion measurements or full peripheral operation.
The ES8311 multi-byte read did not match the individual reads; register auto-increment has not been established.
The UART logs and identifying EEPROM fields remain private.
